items.name: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu IV 2025
items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: **[Galo]** Enlist'ous **pour de ren** si qe v'étes un **nouvè coursou** ou ben un [**souétou de l'AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Aoterment d'aotr l'enlistement coûte 5 nuros. Merci de **ben lire les condicions d'enlistement, la [Faire ao qhessions](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) e les [ghides d'espliqes de l'AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Sonjéz etout d'ergarder den l'ongllet [Programe](#competition-schedule). --- **[Brezhoneg]** **Digoust** eo an enskrivadur evit ar **genstriverien nevez** hag [**izili an AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). A-hend-all e koust an enskrivadur 5€. Mar plij, **lennit aketus ar c'hondisionoù evit lakaat e anv, an [FAG](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) ha [teulioù kennel an AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Taolit ur sell d'an ivinell [Steuñvad](#competition-schedule) ivez. --- **[Français]** L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€. Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). ---- **[English]** Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€. Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**. Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab. --- **[Esperanto]** Registriĝi estas **senpaga** por la **novaj konkursantoj** kaj [**AFS-membroj**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), ne gravas kia civitaneco vi havas aŭ kie vi loĝas. Alie, registriĝi kostas 5 eŭroj. Bonvolu legi la **registriĝajn kondiĉojn, la [oftajn demandojn](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) kaj la [AFS-lernilojn](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) zorgeme**. Legu ankaŭ la langeton [Horplano](#competition-schedule).

items.information: ###Dieser Wettkampf wird in zwei Gruppen durchgeführt. Du wirst in einer Gruppe antreten und in der anderen Gruppe entweder als Runner, Judge oder Scrambler mithelfen. Du MUSST während der gesamten Dauer beider Gruppen anwesend sein (d.h. von 17:45 bis 21:00 Uhr), sonst darfst du nicht teilnehmen. ###Bitte lies vor deiner Anmeldung unbedingt die Reiter „Rush-Hour Format“ und "Main Event". ###This competition will be run in two groups. You will compete in one group and help out in the other group as a runner, judge, or scrambler. You MUST be present for the entire duration of both groups (i.e. from 17:45 to 21:00), otherwise you cannot participate. ###Please make sure to read the tab “Rush-Hour Format” and "Main Event" carefully before registering.

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard. Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.name: Svealandsmästerskapet 2025
items.information: Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)". ----- Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Svealand Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)". items.information: # West Coast Cubing welcomes you to Las Vegas for Western Championship 2025! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODU4NzksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--0ca43cca8d2fb3caa9578fb8c494c9ed9e1e7a9f/1000018351.png) ### **Please visit the [Key Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2025#58976-key-information) tab for an overview of everything Western Champs 2025!** The highest placing resident of California, Nevada, or Hawaii in each event at this competition will be recognized as the Western Champion! items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODU1MTQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--cef753cc0422223e223e2696d2d751a45d058f8b/UKC25_LOGO_-_FOR_WCA_WEBSITE.jpg) ## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2025! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering. ##### Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish! **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2025, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2025 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2025#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 10th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.** **Final Round Advancements:** The top 6 UK competitors will be [guaranteed to progress](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#9p2b) into the finals for all events, in addition to the top 10 remaining best competitors of any region. For 3x3, the top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at the Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2025. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2025. **Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. **Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE0MDI2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--796bec32f0666d29384682342b18ff943a53d2ee/NMLogo.png) ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2025, denne gangen hold i Lierskogen. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2025#55231-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇬🇧 Information Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2025, held in Lierskogen. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2025#55231-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAzMTc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2f863d51aca44602df4916ae5a0e5ef1e278b5af/GO%202025.png) **Español** **¡Bienvenidos a Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025!** La Guelaguetza es mucho más que una simple festividad, es el corazón mismo de la cultura oaxaqueña. Representa la esencia de la generosidad, la solidaridad y la comunidad que caracteriza a este hermoso estado de México. En la Guelaguetza, las personas se reúnen para compartir, celebrar y fortalecer los lazos que los unen como comunidad. Y ¿qué mejor manera de expresar esta conexión que a través de los cubos Rubik? Al resolver este rompecabezas, no solo estamos demostrando habilidad y destreza, sino también la capacidad de unirnos en un desafío común, sin importar nuestro origen o cultura. ¡No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de este encuentro único, donde los cubos se convierten en símbolos de conexión y celebración! ¡Te esperamos en la **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025**! **English** **Welcome to Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025!** The Guelaguetza is much more than just a celebration — it is the very heart of Oaxacan culture. It represents the essence of generosity, solidarity, and community that defines this beautiful state of Mexico. During Guelaguetza, people come together to share, celebrate, and strengthen the bonds that unite them as a community. And what better way to express this connection than through Rubik’s Cubes? By solving this puzzle, we are not only showcasing skill and dexterity, but also the ability to unite around a shared challenge, regardless of our background or culture. Don’t miss the chance to be part of this unique gathering, where cubes become symbols of connection and celebration! We’ll see you at **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025**!

items.information: ***English version is below*** **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Linz Summer 2025 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Marcel Niedl und Sebastian Feichtinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Das Turnier findet im Volkshaus Ebelsberg statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the Linz Summer 2025 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Marcel Niedl and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

Cholula, sus 37 iglesias y sus aires prehispánicos están listos para recibirte en esta nueva competencia. Tendrás una sola ronda para demostrar por que eres el mejor. Cada segundo y resolución será decisiva desde el primer intento. ¿Tienes lo que se necesita para ser el más rápido? ¡Acepta el reto y gira hacia la victoria! Esto es, **¡Todo o Nada!** Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Municipo de **"San Andrés Cholula"** y a la Presidenta Municipal **Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**. Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 20215 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ ##### English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to **Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025**! Cholula, with its 37 churches and pre-Hispanic spirit, is ready to welcome you to this new competition. You’ll have just one round to prove why you’re the best. Every second and every solve will be decisive from the very first attempt. Do you have what it takes to be the fastest? Take the challenge and twist your way to victory! This is All or Nothing! This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the Municipality of **San Andrés Cholula** and **Municipal President Guadalupe Cuautle Torres.** Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025 is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.information: **Important Information for Participants**: **Location**: The competition will take place at the main school hall. **Arrival Time**: Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be permitted to participate. **Volunteering**: All participants are kindly requested to volunteer during the competition. **First-Time Participants**: If this is your first time participating in a WCA competition or if you're unfamiliar with the competition rules, we strongly recommend reviewing the WCA regulations beforehand. **ID Requirement**: First-time participants are required to bring a scanned copy of their ID card. Please ensure you have this with you. **Cube Requirement**: Participants must bring their own cubes. If you have difficulty bringing puzzles, please contact us in advance so that we can make arrangements for you. **International Participants**: If you are a citizen from outside India, please submit both a physical and photo copy of your ID. We look forward to seeing you at the competition! If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.

items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2025! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTcxOTcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b0423464106a5bf4730ca8189b9c1cd1a18f9149/Oslo%20Open%202025.PNG)

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard. Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information: ## Português Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](link da página de inscrições da sua competição). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$20. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- ## English Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](link da página de inscrições da sua competição) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R$20. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: **Português** Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 20 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! - Inscrições no dia do campeonato estarão abertas somente para 3x3x3. **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition 20 minutes before the modality that you will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubers. - Try to have a lot of fun! - Entries on the day of the competition will only be open for 3x3x3.

items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025! ### This competition is open to everyone to compete in, regardless of nationality or experience level. [![Kewbz](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1Y0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b3fb56d1f073b7544d2cf011acfe92e29f237f69/Kewbz_Logo.png)](https://ukspeedcubes.co.uk/) ![Scottish Championship Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQyNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c4ab4fd8fb34605abb30bab45291a8318375f865/Scottish%20Champs%20Logo.png) #### New Competitors: If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52598-faq) and the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52599-important-information) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. #### Free T-Shirt: By registering and attending Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025, you'll receive a free Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025 T-shirt! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size. A sizing guide is provided in the** [T-Shirt tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52603-t-shirt-sizes). #### Qualifications: **3x3, 2x2, 4x4, Skewb, Pyraminx, and 3x3 One-Handed do not have any qualification requirements and remain open to everyone, including new competitors, to compete in**. Other events have qualification requirements in place. If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025/#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by May 19th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. #### Spectators and Guests: Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There is no need to pre-book. #### Prizes: As this is the Kewbz Scottish Championship, **only competitors who are Scottish** (please see the [prizes eligiblity tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#53036-prizes-eligibility) for further details) **will be eligible for prizes**. The competition remains open for competitors of all nationalities and UK regions to compete. #### Podium Positions: If fewer than three Scottish competitors proceed to the final of an event, any remaining podium positions will be determined using the results of the highest ranked Scottish competitors in the previous round. #### Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025: The Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025 will be held separately on Saturday 24th May in Glasgow. This competition will host 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind, and 3x3 Fewest Moves. Podiummers at the Blind Off will be crowned at Kewbz Scottish Championship. #### Invitation Letters: Should you need a Visa invitation letter, or a note from us to help authorise time off school, please [get in touch](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition). #### Media Enquiries: Please [contact us](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition) for all media enquiries.

items.name: Saint-Augustin B 2025
items.information: ## [FR] ### Série Saint-Augustin 2025 Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours, pour offrir une variété maximale d'épreuves! Vous pouvez choisir entre [Saint-Augustin 2025 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (samedi) et [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (dimanche). Ces compétitions ont des événements différents. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Saint-Augustin 2025 Series One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series, to offer the most event variety we can! You can choose between [Saint-Augustin 2024 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (Saturday) or [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (Sunday). These competitions are have different event sets. You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** ### Registration Reminders You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdUplIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--92701aef7af516be4361993a7c4150fa9e22ea2d/image.png) **Western Development Museum: The registration fee for this competition includes admission to the Western Development Museum for the competitors and their guests.** There will be a longer lunch break in the competition schedule so everyone can enjoy the museum. Learn more about the WDM at their website [here](https://wdm.ca/north-battleford/). We ask attendees to limit themselves to two guest per competitor if possible so that we do not go over capacity limits for this venue which is 240 people. Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in. **First Time Competitors:** All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition. **Megaminx and Square-1:** There will be no cutoff for Megaminx or Square-1 at this competition. The cumulative time limit for megaminx is 30 minutes. You may take over 10 minutes to do a single solve if you let your judge know beforehand. Megaminx is scheduled such that overflow into lunch is acceptable so everyone can get results. **Draw prizes:** There will be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done. **Notice of Filming and Photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown I 2025
items.information: Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2025. Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ The Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2025, made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup.

Será um prazer recebê-los. **VEJA AS ATUALIZAÇÕES DA COMPETIÇÃO NO NOSSO INSTAGRAM** **@riocubolympics** Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! ### ENGLISH ### Welcome to Rio Cubolympics 2025! It will be a pleasure to welcome you. **SEE THE UPDATES OF THE COMPETITIONS ON OUR INSTAGRAM** **@riocubolympics** Tips: - Arrive at the competition location at least 30 minutes before the category you will participate in; - The cube you will compete with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers. Have a lot of fun!

El Corazón de la Axarquía 2025 is being held in honour of Owen Pérez, a young cuber who sadly suddenly passed away in 2024. Owen competed in the UMA Open 2023 and the Ecija Open 2024. As well as being a talented cuber, he was a smart, creative and fun boy, and he is greatly missed.

items.information: #Please check the schedule to find possible time slots. Please indicate in the registration comments what timeslot you would prefer to compete in. #Competitors may register for 3x3 and up to one of the following events: 2x2, Skewb, Pyraminx, Megaminx, Clock, or Square-1. Competitors may not register for more than two events, and if they register for two events, one of them must be 3x3. - On-site registration will be the expo's $30 entrance fee plus $5 paid to us on the spot. - Specify the time you would prefer to compete in the registration comments. We will email everyone their time slot once registration has closed. Time slots will be determined based on a first-come first-serve basis. If your desired time slot is full, we will reach out via email and ask for another time slot. - If you would like to modify your events you are registered for, please contact us through the contact form for this competition and we will modify your registration accordingly. *In a catastrophic event where the event will be compromised and cancelled, a full refund shall be offered to all competitors, in contrast to the typical 95% registration refunds.* ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcmhuIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--26e7dd6ac4909eb7484f685f1f010ff228529aaf/main.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcUJOIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--573fdf538a21acdaa5aaf068feb5551af8f5c1df/Logo_big.png) #This is an expo first! Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. - Spectators will have to pay entry to the expo. Tickets may be purchased ahead of time at the [EVO Sports Expo website](https://www.evosportsglobal.com/evo-store/p/santa-clara-evo-expo-ticket) for $30, or in person the day of. - We urge competitors with spectators (especially minors) to not register for the first timeslot; however, a guardian (with a spectator ticket purchased) will be able to enter early with the competitors, it will be more straightforward to register for any timeslot but the first.

Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. items.information: 🇧🇷 **Português** ** Bem-vindos à primeira competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!! ** Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica. Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2025 promete a inserção do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo alcançar a representatividade também no Esporte para o Cérebro! Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento! Nos vemos lá! 🇬🇧 **English:** ** Welcome to the first speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!! ** Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas. Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions. Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport too! Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event! We will meet there!

items.information: ### WCA Newcomer Month ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjAzODksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f4703bb8694974000e48f846fd2d76ffa28f318/newcomer.jpg) [FR] Cette compétition fait partie du mois officiel des débutants WCA 2025. Le processus d'inscription réservera 50 % des places pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Les nouveaux compétiteurs sont considérés comme n'ayant pas d'ID WCA ou ayant un ID WCA datant de 2025. Les anciens compétiteurs sont considérés comme ayant un ID WCA datant d'avant 2024. Les inscriptions seront acceptées selon les critères suivants : 50 % des places sont réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs, et l'autre moitié est disponible pour les autres compétiteurs, selon le principe du premier arrivé, premier servi. Si les nouveaux compétiteurs s'inscrivent rapidement et remplissent plus de 50 % des places, les autres nouveaux compétiteurs seront acceptés en même temps que les anciens. Si les places réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs ne sont pas toutes prises avant la clôture des inscriptions (deux semaines avant la compétition), les places restantes seront ouvertes pour tous. [EN] This competition is part of the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID from 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjM0NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7f38aa440f2f5ea4ba0f22de16d4f6cdf4c47946/IMG-20250124-WA0034.jpg) ​ ##### Español ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ¡Bienvenidos a **Mega-Mente Puebla 2025**! Puebla se prepara para recibirte en un torneo que pondrá a prueba tus habilidades y conocimientos. **¿Qué tan lejos puede llegar tu mente?** El nombre del torneo y nuestra categoría principal no son coincidencia. Cada detalle ha sido pensado para resaltar la conexión entre la fuerza mental y el desafío que representa este evento. El Megaminx, con su forma dodecaédrica, representa un verdadero desafío para la mente, exigiendo combinar estrategia, eficiencia, precisión, visión espacial y velocidad. Así es como Megaminx se convierte en el corazón de este torneo, acompañado de otras categorías desafiantes que pondrán a prueba tu mente. Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Mega-Mente Puebla 2025 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ ##### English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to **Mega-Mente Puebla 2025**! Puebla is ready to welcome you to a tournament that will challenge your knowledge and skills. **How far can your mind go?** The name of the tournament and our main category are no coincidence. Every detail has been carefully designed to highlight the connection between mental strength and the challenge this event represents. The Megaminx, with its dodecahedral shape, embodies a true mental challenge, demanding a combination of strategy, efficiency, precision, spatial awareness, and speed. This is why the Megaminx becomes the heart of this tournament, accompanied by other challenging categories that will put your mind to the test. This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Mega-Mind Puebla 2025 is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard. Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. items.information: ##Português: **Competidores, atenção aos seguintes avisos:** - Esta competição *não terá a modalidade* ***3x3x3*** ; - Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização**; - O competidor poderá se inscrever antecipadamente pelo site e sua inscrição será confirmada apenas com o pagamento da taxa via PIX: **fbgrac@gmail.com**, após isso enviar comprovante para o mesmo e-mail, contendo o print do comprovante e o nome do competidor. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **Caso o limite de 28 competidores não seja atingido, estaremos aceitando inscrições no local pelo preço de R$21, por ordem de chegada** ##English: **Competitors, heed the following warnings:** - This competition *will NOT have* the ***3x3x3*** event; - This competition will have a limit on competitors. Register only if you are **sure that you will participate**. In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization**; - The competitor may register in advance on the website and their registration will only be confirmed upon payment of the fee via PIX: **fbgrac@gmail.com**, after which send proof of registration to the same email, containing the print of the proof of registration and the name of the competitor. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **If the competitor limit of 28 isn't reached, we will be accepting on the spot registrations for the price of R$21, in order of arrival**

items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Chill Out Trondheim 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Chill Out Trondheim 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information: **Português** Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Taxas de inscrição não serão devolvidas em nenhuma circunstância. - Não serão aceitas inscrições no local. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Registration fees will not be refunded under any circumstances. - On-site registrations will not be accepted. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: Välkomna till Twixmas Flen 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. **OBS:** På fredagen hålls endast ett försök 3x3 Multi-BLD. Om du inte tävlar i den grenen behöver du inte komma redan på fredagen, utan det räcker att du kommer först innan din första gren ska börja på lördagen. ----- Welcome to Twixmas Flen 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. **N.B.:** On Friday, only one attempt of 3x3 Multi-BLD will be held. If you do not want to compete in that event, you do not have to come already on Friday, it is enough that you arrive first before your first event starts on Saturday. items.information: ### On the spot registration is open for 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb events only. Kejuaraan Speedcubing Nasional untuk Indonesia pada tahun 2024. Peserta dari segala usia dan kewarganegaraan dipersilakan untuk mengikuti. Harap diperhatikan tentang limit dan cutoff untuk setiap event, karena lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya. Akan ada **2 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini: **Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan **Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori Peserta atau pendamping harus setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi, atau kerusakan atau kehilangan barang pribadi anda yang diakibatkan oleh partisipasi Anda dalam acara ini. Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, silakan periksa **Persyaratan Pendaftaran.** Biaya pendaftaran termasuk, Sertifikat Partisipasi, Lanyard, dan Name Tag. Silahkan melakukan registrasi di website WCA dan konfirmasi di [form ini](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9) *Harap perhatikan jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka karena dapat berubah tergantung pada jumlah orang yang mendaftar untuk setiap acara.* --- ### Registrasi OTS dibuka hanya untuk cabang 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, dan Skewb. The National Speedcubing Championship for Indonesia in 2024. Competitiors of all ages and nationality are welcomed to join. Please notice the time limit and cutoff on each events, as they are stricter than regular competitions. There will be **2 types of winners** in this competition: **Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality **Indonesian Category** - Top 3 winners representing the Indonesia in each category Competitor or guardian must agree that the organizers, NSA and WCA shall not be liable for any personal injury, property damage or loss resulting from your participation of this event. For more information, please check the **Registration Requirements.** Registration fee includes, Certificate of Participation, Lanyard and Name Tag. Please register in the WCA website and confirm your registration by filling out [this form](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9) *Please keep an eye on our schedule during the open registration period as it may change depending on the number of people registering for each event.*

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara! Desde o ano passados, estamos trabalhando com doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Estamos trabalhando em conjunto com o [LEO e Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) para arrecadar brinquedos e alimentos para crianças carentes, então todo o lucro da competição será revertido para essa campanha. Além disso, se você quiser fazer uma doação no dia, também será muito bem-vinda. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** It is in great excitement that we announce a new Capivara! Starting last year, we are working with donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. We are working together with [LEO and Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) to collect toys and food to children in need, so all profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. Besides that, if you would like to give a donation on the spot, it will also be very welcome. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=6Yf5Zun_nlTfECTy). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

Το 2024 έγιναν οι περισσότεροι διαγωνισμοί στην Ελλάδα από κάθε άλλη χρονιά, οπότε δεν θα μπορούσε αυτό το ταξίδι να μην τελειώσει με αυτή τη μεγάλη γιορτή! Please read through the following tabs to find all the necessary information about the 2024 Nationals Important Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register through the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the next tabs. items.information: ### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다. ### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/52/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/52/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오. ### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/52/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/52/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list. ### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.information: Välkomna till Norrlandsmästerskapet 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. items.information: Els socis de l'ACSC reben un descompte del 15% després de la competició. Pots fer-te soci de l'ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). Aquesta competició no té una categoria principal. El guanyador de la competició es decidirà mitjançant el “Sum of Ranks”. Això consisteix a sumar totes les posicions en què ha quedat un competidor a totes les categories, i qui obtingui el nombre més baix serà qui millor ha actuat en tot el llarg de la competició i, per tant, el guanyador. ​ Los socios de la ACSC reciben un descuento del 15% después de la competición. Puedes hacerte socio de la ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). Esta competición no tiene una categoría principal. El ganador de la competición se decidirá mediante “Sum of Ranks”. Esto consiste a sumar todas las posiciones en que ha quedado un competidor en todas las categorías, y quién obtenga el número más bajo será quien mejor ha actuado a lo largo de toda la competición y, por tanto, el ganador. ​ The ACSC members will receive a 15% discount after the end of the competition. You can become a member of the ACSC [here](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). This competition does not have a main event. The winner of the competition will be decided through the “Sum of Ranks”. This consists of adding all the positions in which a competitor has remained in all categories, and the one who obtain the lowest number will be the one who has performed best throughout the competition and, therefore, the winner.

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2024
items.information: ## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2024! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering. ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#41928-guests-spectators-and-media) tab. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2024, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2024 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Guests:** A fee of £5 for a guest wristband will be due for all spectators and competitors' guests. They will be available on the door, payable via cash or card. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** Please note that the guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only. **Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by October 22nd you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.** **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1: 6 UK competitors; 3x3: 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2024). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2024. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ # There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition. ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/51/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/51/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list. ### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.name: Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024#48216-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024#48216-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information: 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 – Астанадағы 24 сағаттық ашық жарыс. Бұл жарыстар 24 сағат үзіліссіз өтеді, сондықтан олар жас және жаңа қатысушыларға ұсынылмайды. Кез келген пәндер санына қатысу мүмкіндігімен базалық жарна 3000 теңгені құрайды. 1 кез келген пәнге тіркелу кезінде тіркеу жарнасы 1000 теңгені құрайды. Бұл жарыстарды QBERS TEAM ұйымдастырады. 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 - это первые открытые 24-х часовые соревнования в Астане. Данные соревнования будут проходить без перерывов 24 часа, следовательно не рекомендуются для юных и новых участников. Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 3000 тенге. При регистрации на 1 любую дисциплину регистрационный взнос составит 1000 тенге. Данные сореванования организованы QBERS TEAM. 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 is the first open 24-hour competition in Astana. These competitions will take place without breaks for 24 hours, therefore they are not recommended for young and new participants. The base registration fee for any number of events is 3000 tenge. If you're participating in 1 event only, the registration fee is 1000 tenge. These competition is organized by QBERS TEAM.

Ukoliko se takmičite samo u 3x3 i 2x2 kocki cena kotizacije iznosi 1,000RSD , ali ukoliko se takmičite u više disciplina plaćate punu cenu od 2,000RSD. Ovo nije standardna praksa i ovo pravilo važi samo za ovo takmičenje.** ------------------------ (ENG) Belgrade Open 2024 is the 22nd speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. **Registration fee for this competition depends on which events you are competing in. If you are competing in only 3x3 and 2x2 cubes, you will pay 1,000RSD, but if you are competing in more events, you will pay the full amount of 2,000RSD. This is not a standard practice, and this rule applies only to this competition.**

Le déroulement de la compétition pourra vous paraître lent, car certaines limites de temps sont élevées. Consultez les autres onglets pour des informations additionnelles très importantes sur la compétition. *Note : Certains textes dans ce site web sont en anglais uniquement. Veuillez nous en excuser car les organisateurs ne peuvent faire autrement en utilisant ce site web*. ###**Avis de droit à l'image** Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leur image soit utilisée par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et sur d'autres plateformes numériques. ##**[EN]** There will be **no refunds after the registration period closes**. If you register and you are not able to come, please let us know as soon as possible to let someone else have a chance to participate. You will be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the registration period closes. Please read all the terms and conditions below carefully before registering. *If you study at Cégep Trois-Rivières, please enter your matricule number in the comments of your registration*. The pace of the competition may seem slow to you, as some time limits are high. See the other tabs for very important additional information about the competition. ###**Notice of Filming and Photography** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their image being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
